response.sql: WITH budget_event AS (SELECT b.budget_id, b.spent, b.remaining, b.amount, b.link_to_event, e.event_id, e.status FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), event_level AS (SELECT event_id, status, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, AVG((spent - amount) / amount) as avg_overspend_rate FROM budget_event GROUP BY event_id, status), status_level AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining_per_status, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate_per_status FROM event_level GROUP BY status), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_per_status) as global_mean_remaining FROM status_level) SELECT sl.status, sl.avg_remaining_per_status as average_remaining, sl.avg_overspend_rate_per_status as average_overspend_rate, sl.avg_remaining_per_status / gm.global_mean_remaining as normalized_remaining FROM status_level sl, global_mean gm ORDER BY sl.status;

assumptions.assumption: budget.amount is never zero, as the overspend_rate calculation (spent - amount) / amount divides by amount.
